scope: Final upstream-quality architectural recommendations by use case from the user's starred repositories and three explicitly identified additions. This bounded review supports research and engineering infrastructure; it does not qualify strategy, market data, execution or brokers.

publication_policy.adoption_effect: None. Existing deployment selections, manifests/stack.json pins, historical evidence and independently owned blind trials remain unchanged.
publication_policy.catalog_synthesis_effect: Additive dated input; does not finalize the separate 79-slot catalog consolidation or replace any owner's result.
publication_policy.release_policy: Observed upstream releases and reviewed default/develop branch commits are distinct. These records are not deployment lockfiles or accepted release artifacts.
publication_policy.source_review_policy: Architecture selection is based on cited upstream engineering quality. Runtime qualification and representative comparative performance remain separate; no experiment is queued by this record.

stacks.title: General agent memory and document RAG

responsibilities.memory: Hindsight retains agent knowledge and temporal/entity context.
responsibilities.retrieval: Qdrant stores searchable document evidence; Haystack composes indexing, hybrid retrieval, ranking and answer context.
responsibilities.measurement: Opik records traces, datasets and directly tested evaluations.

stacks.why: Strong role separation, public source/evaluation paths and documented component integrations; substantial database and pipeline test coverage.
operating_requirements: Hindsight's supported PostgreSQL/vector backend and model configuration.
A separately scoped document collection in Qdrant and Docling ingestion resources.
Pinned Docling/Haystack/Qdrant integrations, generation and embedding/reranking providers.
One tracing owner; Opik's failing Ragas adapter is not assumed usable.
stacks.qualification: Proposed composition; documented pairwise integrations do not establish an executed full stack.

stacks.title: Codex/Claude coding continuity
stacks.recommendation: Preferred coding architecture on upstream engineering merits

responsibilities.memory: ai-memory owns durable project knowledge and typed handoffs.
responsibilities.optional_semantics: SocratiCode serves conceptual/mixed code-and-infrastructure retrieval when that requirement is present.

stacks.why: Recovery and cross-client continuity have a distinct owner; code structure is retrieved from source. Optional semantic infrastructure must have a separate role.
operating_requirements: Verified project identity and access scope.
One owner per memory service and index.
Compatible official artifacts and backup/recovery procedure; SocratiCode adds vector/embedding infrastructure.
stacks.qualification: Does not upgrade a deployed ai-memory pin or settle independently owned memory/code-search experiments.

stacks.title: Personalized application with document evidence

responsibilities.documents: Docling, Haystack and Qdrant provide independently scoped source evidence.
responsibilities.measurement: Opik captures traces and task-specific evaluation.

stacks.why: Mem0's application APIs and successful current SDK checks suit personalization. It replaces the general stack's Hindsight memory role rather than adding a second owner.
operating_requirements: Explicit separation of personalization stores and document collections.
An OSS configuration whose capabilities and benchmarks are not borrowed from proprietary managed optimizations.
stacks.qualification: Models, package lock and full application evaluation remain unspecified.

stacks.title: Packaged document-RAG application

responsibilities.application: Use RAGFlow's supported parsing, retrieval, citation and application services as one product stack.

stacks.why: Strong packaged OCR/layout/table handling and inspectable source chunks/citations.
operating_requirements: Upstream-supported multi-service deployment and model configuration.
Evaluate established v0.27.2 separately from the Go v1.0.0-rc1 transition; neither is accepted for installation by this review.
stacks.qualification: Reviewed Go-era main has failing backend integration tests; those failures are not attributed to the older release without evidence.

stacks.title: Connected workplace knowledge

responsibilities.application: Onyx owns connectors, permission-aware ingestion, indexing and the search/agent application.

stacks.why: Connector and permission requirements favor the application designed around those operations.
operating_requirements: Standard indexing mode; Lite cannot index documents.
Confirm needed features against MIT core and separately licensed Enterprise directories.
Upstream-supported worker, database and model services.
stacks.qualification: Observed image-build network failure is not a retrieval-quality failure or release acceptance.

specialists.use_when: Long text-heavy documents need hierarchical reasoning retrieval with page references.
specialists.limit: Local OSS lacks OCR/image understanding; published benchmark excludes tables/charts/arithmetic.

specialists.use_when: Images, tables, equations or multimedia need integrated retrieval.
specialists.limit: Parser/model integration remains application work; complete reproduction was not audited.

specialists.use_when: One inspectable context system spanning memory, knowledge and skills is an explicit architectural requirement.
specialists.limit: AGPL scope and its own lifecycle must be considered; no matched quality lead was shown.

specialists.use_when: Explicit graph relationships, ontologies and connected organizational knowledge dominate the requirement.
specialists.limit: Separate licensing on some production paths and current failed cloud/image checks.

unresolved: Embedding, sparse-retrieval, reranking and generation model choices and exact model revisions.
Cross-component package locks, deployment configuration and immutable release-image digests.
Representative ingest/retrieve/rerank/generate/cite/evaluate/remember lifecycle, latency, recovery and complete cost.
Independent matched comparative evaluation; vendor benchmark methodologies differ.
overturn_rule: A cited upstream regression, licensing/compatibility gap, independent matched result or simpler architecture meeting the same requirements can revise the relevant recommendation. Preserve this dated review and its failures when superseding it.
